host.title: Host name
host.description: Fully qualified domain name under which Open WebUI is published.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

webui_name.title: Interface name
webui_name.description: Display name shown in the Open WebUI interface (WEBUI_NAME).

ollama_base_url.title: Ollama base URL
ollama_base_url.description: URL of your external Ollama instance, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:11434 (OLLAMA_BASE_URL). Separate several with ';'. Leave empty to add connections later inside the UI.

enable_signup.title: Allow self-registration
enable_signup.description: Let visitors create their own local account (ENABLE_SIGNUP). The very first account always becomes the administrator. Not needed when users log in via AD/LDAP.

default_user_role.title: Default role for new accounts
default_user_role.description: Role assigned to newly registered or first-login LDAP users (DEFAULT_USER_ROLE). 'pending' requires admin approval before login.

enable_openai_api.title: Enable OpenAI-compatible API
enable_openai_api.description: Also allow external OpenAI-compatible endpoints in addition to Ollama (ENABLE_OPENAI_API).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: TZ database name for scheduling and log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

rag_embedding_engine.title: Embedding engine
rag_embedding_engine.description: Initial embedding engine for the knowledge base (RAG_EMBEDDING_ENGINE). Empty = Open WebUI's built-in model. Applied only when an instance is first set up; it does not change an instance that already holds documents (change the embedding in the admin panel and re-index).

rag_embedding_model.title: Embedding model
rag_embedding_model.description: Initial embedding model (RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL), e.g. bge-m3:latest for the Ollama engine. Seed value only; a later change must be made in the Open WebUI admin panel together with a re-index of the knowledge bases.

rag_top_k.title: Top K
rag_top_k.description: Initial number of knowledge-base passages retrieved per query (RAG_TOP_K). Empty = Open WebUI default (3).

rag_chunk_size.title: Chunk size
rag_chunk_size.description: Initial document chunk size for indexing (CHUNK_SIZE). Empty = Open WebUI default (1000).

rag_chunk_overlap.title: Chunk overlap
rag_chunk_overlap.description: Initial overlap between document chunks (CHUNK_OVERLAP). Empty = Open WebUI default (100).

ldap_enabled.title: Enable AD/LDAP login
ldap_enabled.description: Allow login with Active Directory / LDAP accounts (ENABLE_LDAP).

ldap_label.title: Login button label
ldap_label.description: Text shown on the LDAP login option (LDAP_SERVER_LABEL), e.g. 'Active Directory'.

ldap_mail_attribute.title: Mail attribute
ldap_mail_attribute.description: Attribute holding the user's e-mail (LDAP_ATTRIBUTE_FOR_MAIL). Open WebUI requires every user to have one. Defaults to mail; on Active Directory where mail is not populated, use userPrincipalName.

ldap_source.title: Directory
ldap_source.description: domain: a user domain of this cluster (no credentials stored in the module); custom: an LDAP server entered here.

ldap_domain.title: User domain
ldap_domain.description: User domain of the cluster whose users may log in (ldap_source domain).

ldap_group.title: Group
ldap_group.description: Only members of this group (also nested AD groups) may log in: a group name, for an LDAP server of its own also a DN; empty allows every user.

ldap_start_tls.title: StartTLS
ldap_start_tls.description: Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS. Not supported by Open WebUI; use ldaps:// instead.

ldap_tls_verify.title: Verify the server certificate
ldap_tls_verify.description: Check the LDAP server certificate against the system CAs (ldaps://).

ldap_schema.title: Directory type
ldap_schema.description: ad (Active Directory, Samba) or rfc2307 (OpenLDAP posixAccount).

ldap_bind_dn.title: Bind DN
ldap_bind_dn.description: Service account used to look up users.

ldap_bind_password.title: Bind password
ldap_bind_password.description: New password of the service account; empty keeps the stored one. Stored in state/passwords.env.
